evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt.

observations.why: Two negative clauses in matched structure ('No X, and no Y if Z') set deliberate contrast — absence of blocking paired with absence of lost work — a performed antithesis, not incidental.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Matched disjunctive structure across two clauses ('either polls X or gets Y on Z') — a parallel arrangement of two alternatives doing structural work, not a plain list.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Is the expression performing a rule or guarantee through deliberately opposed parallel clauses rather than stating it plainly?
